trip_keeper.text: Welcome in. We are carved right into the castle rock. If the wall looks like a cave, that is because it is one.
The sign says 1189, the year Richard the Lionheart became king. Historians say the pub is mainly 17th century. The caves underneath are far older.
The caves were once storerooms for the castle. Today they hold cosy corners and a very polite breeze.
See the ship in the glass case, covered in dust? Nobody cleans it. Legend says that is wise.
